meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会启动一个本地监控面板,展示代理组、会话、频道、用户、Token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动与实时日志。面板每 60 秒接收一次数据快照,每 2 秒接收一次日志流。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表板,或提到“dashboard”、“监控面板”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控仪表板。
帮 NanoClaw 添加 dashboard,端口用 3200。
给 NanoClaw 装监控面板,然后验证一下。
say.note: Claude 会运行构建和测试,并确认面板可访问。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw runs a local dashboard showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs. It gets a data snapshot every 60s and a log stream every 2s.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or mentions keywords like 'dashboard' or 'monitoring panel'.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude installs the package, copies the pusher, and configures env vars.

say_en.text: Add a dashboard to NanoClaw on port 3200.
Set up the dashboard and verify it.
say_en.note: Claude runs build and tests, then checks the panel.
